registration.method: Esri World Imagery z17/z18 tiles composed by ribbingsforsbuild/sat-crop.mjs. The mapping local -> EPSG:3006 -> WGS84 -> tile is computed per point with the repo's own Krüger series, so a tile's coordinates ARE its georeference and there is no registration fit to drift. Reading error is the eye against calibrated 100/200 m gridlines: about ±8 m at z18, ±15 m at z17.
registration.checks: The model's break-geometry water rings, OSM roads and hole-3 green pond all land on their imagery counterparts within reading error; the provisional hole lines land on mown corridors.

corrections: The provisional driving-range ellipse in build-course.mjs (centred about [124,-356]) lies on open lake water in the imagery. The real practice ground is the mown block between the hole-9 and hole-1 corridors south of the clubhouse; the range trace below replaces it.

OSM's ele=66.9 on the Skagern relation disagrees with the Lantmäteriet break geometry (69.3) and with the laser-flat open-water reading of the committed vista heightfield (69.35 at [4000,-3000] and [3000,-4000]). The laser level 69.3 is authoritative.

villageHouses.note: Skagersvik's village grid is largely unmapped in OSM (only the industrial halls carry footprints). Houses are synthesized by apply-surroundings.mjs inside the OSM residential rings, aligned to the nearest street — the Ås precedent from geobuild.
